## Page 1

BOROUGH OF ATLANTIC HIGHLANDS  
COUNTY OF MONMOUTH 
 
RESOLUTION 068-2025 
 
Awarding Contract for Upper Prospect Road Wall 
Emergency Repairs 
 
WHEREAS, there is an immediate need for emergency repairs to the municipal retaining 
wall on Upper Prospect Road. 
 
WHEREAS, the Borough has classified these improvements as an emergency in 
accordance with New Jersey Local Public Contracts Law section 40A:11-6 Emergency 
Contracts due to the critical nature of this situation and its potential impacts on the 
residents on Upper Prospect Road. 
 
WHEREAS, The Borough has received a quote from EZ Dock in the total amount of 
$237,000.00 for temporary stabilization, and 
 
WHEREAS, Ricardo Llanos, Chief Municipal Finance Officer for the Borough of Atlantic 
Highlands, does hereby certify that funds are available for this contract in: 
 
Acct # 5-01-201-44-904-010  
 
(S) Ricardo Llanos, CMFO 
 
NOW THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED by the Governing Body of the Borough of Atlantic 
Highlands that the Upper Prospect Road Wall Emergency Repairs is awarded to EZ Dock 
for the amount of $237,000.00 and that the Mayor, Clerk and/or Borough Administrator 
are authorized to execute the appropriate documents in order to execute the contract and 
any related documents.
